name: Fujieda Neri
source:
2nd year high school student.

She used to live in the poor district, but because of her father's sudden disappearance, Neri transferred into the private Kaikyuu Academy. Cheerful and docile, she fights on when faced with difficulties. Since she was raised with a lot of love, she has a straightforward personality and doesn't understand what it means to be doubtful or distrustful of others. She's good at housework.

[Taken from [URL=http://otome-jikan.net/2014/04/28/zettai-kaikyuu-gakuen-eden-with-roses-and-phantasm/]Otome Jikan[/URL].]
